why: These faces are synthesised, not photographs of real people. A real, identifiable person's photograph must not be attached to a fabricated testimonial, and the stock-library portraits that usually fill this slot are recognisable from other sites. Every face here is public domain and depicts nobody.
processing: Squared on centre at 88% of the frame, nudged down 6% to keep the chin in shot, resized to 256x256 and encoded as WebP q86.
note: The quotes these accompany are placeholders. Replace both the quotes and these pictures with real, consented customer material before launch.
